title: Rusty Saw Blade in Pond
description: A large circular saw blade with a rusted, jagged brown edge rests flat in shallow green water. Bright sunlight reflects intensely from its scratched metallic center, creating a radiant starburst pattern.
prompt: A large, old circular saw blade lies flat in a shallow pond covered with green duckweed and grass. The blade has a heavily rusted jagged outer edge and a scratched metallic center that catches bright sunlight, creating a dramatic radiant starburst reflection. Top down view, natural daylight, realistic details.
